title: Event Envelope v1
description: Standard envelope wrapping every event on the yc-platform bus.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event; used for consumer-side idempotency.

event_type.description: Event type <domain>[.<entity>].<action>.v<N> (ADR-001); matches the schema file name without .json.

tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier: a lowercase slug, or '_platform' for platform-level events. Must equal the tenant segment of the subject (ADR-001).

correlation_id.description: Shared across all events in a logical operation.

causation_id.description: event_id of the direct parent event, if any.

source_service.description: Service or tool that emitted this event (e.g. yc-orders, yc-tenant-cli).

schema_version.description: Schema version matching the version in event_type.

payload.description: Event-specific data. Validated against the event's own schema.
